---
title: "Definition List Layout Test"
format: typst
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensurePdfTextPositions:
        - # Tight item: description sits on the same line as the term
          - subject: "TIGHTTERM"
            relation: leftOf
            object: "TIGHTDESC"
          - subject: "TIGHTTERM"
            relation: topAligned
            object: "TIGHTDESC"
          # Loose item: description stays in a block below the term
          - subject: "LOOSETERM"
            relation: above
            object: "LOOSEDESC"
        - # Description of a loose item is indented, never left-aligned with its term
          - subject: "LOOSEDESC"
            relation: leftAligned
            object: "LOOSETERM"
      noErrors: default
---

Pandoc 3.13 renders definition lists with Typst's native `terms` element and a
hanging indent (upstream replaced its custom `terms.item` show rule with
`#set terms(hanging-indent: 1.5em)`). Tight items keep the description on the
term's line; loose items keep the block layout. Quarto's template ports that
rule, and this document checks both layouts in the PDF.

A tight item:

TIGHTTERM
: TIGHTDESC wraps onto the term line when the item is tight.

A loose item:

LOOSETERM

: LOOSEDESC stays below the term because the item is loose.
